description_en: Submits a tracing watermark extraction job by calling the SubmitTraceExtract operation
description_zh: 调用SubmitTraceExtract接口提交溯源水印提取作业
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-trace-extract --input Bucket_:_example_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.mp4 --user-data 51test --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://example.com/test.mp4 --params example-string --api-version 2021-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTraceExtract

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL after the job is complete.

HTTPS URLs are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
任务完成后的回调地址。

不支持HTTPS地址
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en:
The input bucket of the file from which you want to extract the tracing watermark. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html. If you have not created a media bucket, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42430.html to create one.

The region of OSS must be the same as the region of the current ApsaraVideo Media Processing instance
parameters.help_zh:
待提取溯源水印文件的输入Bucket，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。如果没有创建媒体Bucket，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42430.html创建媒体Bucket。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The user data. No format requirement
parameters.name: user_data

JobId.description_en: The node ID. You can use this ID as a request parameter of the [Query tracing watermark fetch job]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/339735.html） operation to query the job result
JobId.description_zh: 任务ID。可作为[查询溯源水印提取作业]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/339735.html）的请求参数用于查询作业结果
